Name: AT Night Decals
Author: EnbyFelix
Description: 60 retextures of the Night Decals that you get from Penny's 14 heart event (the moon and stars wall decorations). You can buy more of them from this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12956]mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71424903]Asterisk[/url]. To change the textures, buy a paint bucket from Robin, and use it on the decorations.
